contracts: Uses the effective shuffle-elimination option, including its default, and declines empty window partition keys.
Only preceding Windows or column-source storage keys seed the proof; join/aggregate/replicate metadata is not trusted.
Filter and Map walk only through unchanged stages; direct Member aliases preserve type and value identity. Computed extra window keys do not replace required hash keys.
Every ordered input distribution key must have a surviving output IU and a corresponding window partition IU. The chosen key retains input hash order; it never substitutes the whole superset.
Column-source proof is grounded in ResolveStorageColumns, which requires every storage partition column to be present.
Before stage assignment, Window metadata predicts precisely the retained input distribution or the full window shuffle key.
Stage assignment verifies that the published distribution matches its current proof before choosing Map, Shuffle, or gather.
After assignment, metadata is derived from the actual unique connection: shuffle keys, recomputed preservation for Map, otherwise unknown.
IUnaryOperator metadata copy is value-based; changing the Window copy does not mutate its producer.
Map/Filter do not cross stages for admitted column-source and Window producer chains; rejected row-source and Replicate chains cannot invalidate the prestage proof.
No essentials edits and no dependence on a separate C37/C38 fix branch.
limits: Column-source storage co-location and nested-window stage placement still need native distributed checks.
Join/Aggregate/Replicate and other unproved producers deliberately retain repartitioning.
This source review is not execution or optimization-quality verification.
